readerCopy.body: An old refusal can feel so automatic that instinct and history are hard to separate. Lilith conjunct the South Node can bring back the same desire, boundary, anger, or rejection of a role that once felt necessary for self-protection. You may want to leave, expose the problem, reject the expectation, or refuse the compromise before the current situation has fully shown itself. The refusal may still be right. Make sure it belongs to this moment, not only to the person or rule you are still answering from the past.
